verdict.rationale: Crawl4AI is a scraping library, so asking whether developers can build scrapers with Playwright, Puppeteer, Selenium or Scrapy is a fair question. However, no evidence item names any of these libraries or describes writing scrapers with them. The closest items (multi-browser Chromium/Firefox/WebKit support, browser hooks, CDP remote control) are Crawl4AI's own browser features, not documented support for those external libraries, so they are only adjacent.

support.subject: As a developer, I can build scrapers using popular open-source automation libraries like Playwright, Puppeteer, Selenium, or Scrapy
